notes: Tracing and 1ms CPU sampling add overhead; these rounds are excluded from the untraced latency comparison.
Source maps were generated privately with hidden sourcemaps. The corresponding baseline and candidate JavaScript were compared byte-for-byte against the actually served builds before profiling.

Raw CPU timeDeltas include negative values. The analysis preserves them, reconstructs cumulative sample timestamps, sorts samples by those timestamps, then forms nonnegative adjacent intervals and clips their overlap to each phase. Clock correction counts and totals are reported per version. It does not clamp individual negative deltas.

CPU profile milliseconds are approximate reconstructed sampling intervals, rather than exact CPU accounting. CDP ScriptDuration and timeline task/layout/GC events provide separate measurements. GC event families are reported individually because nested GC trace categories overlap.
